title: Something Has Awakened
summary: In the aftermath of the courtyard battle, Ha-Jun escorts Min-Jae to safety as the Demon Hunter Bureau swarms the campus. Far away across dimensions in the Abyssal Realm, Demon King Malgath senses the Sovereign's pulse and mobilizes his armies—marking the grand completion of Arc 1.

panels.action: Wide aerial shot of Saint Mirren University quadrangle in smoking ruins; shattered cobblestones, light rain drizzling over the crater.
panels.prose_en: Wide aerial shot of Saint Mirren University quadrangle in smoking ruins; shattered cobblestones, light rain drizzling over the crater.
panels.prose_hi: Dhumrapan ke khandharon mein sent miren vishwavidyalaya ke chaturbhuj ka vistrit hawai drishya; toote hue patthar, crator par halki baarish ki boondabandi.

panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches his hand down to help Min-Jae up from the wet grass, pulling his trembling friend to his feet.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Utho, Min-Jae. Yahan rukna theek nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches his hand down to help Min-Jae up from the wet grass, pulling his trembling friend to his feet.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun min-je ko gili ghas se upar uthane mein madad karne ke liye apna haath neeche badhata hai, aur apne kampate dost ko apne pairon par khinchta hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae adjusts his crooked glasses with trembling fingers, staring at Ha-Jun's composed silhouette in awe and fear.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Yeh wahi Ha-Jun hai... jise kal sab maarte the...?

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae adjusts his crooked glasses with trembling fingers, staring at Ha-Jun's composed silhouette in awe and fear.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je kampati ungaliyon ke saath apne tedhe-medhe chashme ko samayojit karta hai, Ha-Jun ki rachit chhaya ko vismay aur bhay se dekhta hai.

panels.action: Dozens of high-pitched police and tactical sirens echo across the stone buildings, flashing red and blue against the clouds.
panels.prose_en: Dozens of high-pitched police and tactical sirens echo across the stone buildings, flashing red and blue against the clouds.
panels.prose_hi: Darjanon unchi awaz wali police aur samrik siron, baadalon ke khilaf lal aur neele rang mein chamakte hue, patthar ki imaaraton mein gunjate han.

panels.action: Kuro's telepathic whisper: 'Humein turant nikalna hoga. Bureau ke log aa rahe hain. Insaano ki kanoon yahan sirf rukawat banegi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Nikal yahan se! Bureau ke Hunters aa rahe hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's telepathic whisper: 'Humein turant nikalna hoga. Bureau ke log aa rahe hain. Insaano ki kanoon yahan sirf rukawat banegi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki telepathic fusfusahat: 'hamen turent nikalna hoga. bureau ke log aa rahe han. insaanon ka kanoon yahan sirf rukavat banegi.'

panels.shot: walking side by side to exit
panels.action: Ha-Jun leads Min-Jae down a secluded hedge path behind the gymnasium away from the main gates.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chal sakte ho?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leads Min-Jae down a secluded hedge path behind the gymnasium away from the main gates.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun min-je ko mukhya dwar se door vyayamshala ke peeche ek ekant hej path par le jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun looks back toward the smoke rising from the courtyard: 'Maine bas wahi kiya... jo zaroori tha.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine bas wahi kiya jo zaroori tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks back toward the smoke rising from the courtyard: 'Maine bas wahi kiya... jo zaroori tha.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun peeche mudkar aangan se uthte dhuen ki or dekhta hai: 'maine bus wahi kiya... jo jaruri tha.'

panels.action: A convoy of matte-black tactical SUVs with tinted windows and silver cross insignias screeches through the front gates.
panels.prose_en: A convoy of matte-black tactical SUVs with tinted windows and silver cross insignias screeches through the front gates.
panels.prose_hi: Kale rang ki khidkiyon aur chandi ke cross chinhon ke saath mat-black tactical suv ka ek kaafila samne ke dwaron se gujarta hai.

panels.action: Inside the mobile command van: High-tech holographic monitors illuminate tactical analysts tracking mana wavelengths.
panels.prose_en: Inside the mobile command van: High-tech holographic monitors illuminate tactical analysts tracking mana wavelengths.
panels.prose_hi: Mobyle command van ke ander: high-tek holographic monitor man tarang dairdhya par nazar rakhne wale samrik vishleshakon ko roshan karte han.

panels.action: Special Agent Kang-Doo (scarred face, trench coat, cold demeanor) leans over a 3D hologram of the courtyard crater.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Yeh mana frequency... yeh normal rift nahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Special Agent Kang-Doo (scarred face, trench coat, cold demeanor) leans over a 3D hologram of the courtyard crater.
panels.prose_hi: Vishesh agent cong-du (ghayal chehra, trench kot, thanda aacharan) aangan ke gaddhe ke 3d hologram par jhuk jata hai.

panels.action: A technician points at the spiked waveform graph: 'Captain! Yeh wavelength... Sovereign-class hai!'

dialogue.text: Captain! Yeh Sovereign-class wavelength hai!

panels.prose_en: A technician points at the spiked waveform graph: 'Captain! Yeh wavelength... Sovereign-class hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ek technician nukile tarangrup graph ki or ishara karta hai: 'capton! yeh vevlenth... soweren-clas hai!'.

panels.action: Kang-Doo violently grinds his cigarette out into a metal tray, his teeth gritting in disbelief.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Sovereign-class? Wo bloodline saat saal pehle Tae-Jun ke sath khatam ho gayi thi!

panels.prose_en: Kang-Doo violently grinds his cigarette out into a metal tray, his teeth gritting in disbelief.
panels.prose_hi: Cong-du hinsak tarike se apni cigarette ko metal ki tray mein pista hai, avishvas se uske daant pisne lagte han.

panels.action: The screen shows thermal replay analysis: 'Kisi ne Rank-C Greater Hound ko sirf ek single punch se khatam kar diya.'

dialogue.text: Sirf ek punch se Rank-C beast khatam!

panels.prose_en: The screen shows thermal replay analysis: 'Kisi ne Rank-C Greater Hound ko sirf ek single punch se khatam kar diya.'.
panels.prose_hi: Scrin thermal replay vishleshan dikhati hai: 'kisi ne rank-si greater hound ko sirf ek single panch se khatm kar diya.'

panels.action: Kang-Doo pulls out a crimson-stamped dossier labeled: [THE BLOOD REGISTRY — SUSPECT: HA-JUN KANG].

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Poore campus ko seal karo. Ek ek student ka mana scan lo.

panels.prose_en: Kang-Doo pulls out a crimson-stamped dossier labeled: [THE BLOOD REGISTRY — SUSPECT: HA-JUN KANG].
panels.prose_hi: Cong-du ne ek lal-mudrankit dastavej nikala, jis par label tha: [khoon registry - sandigdh: Ha-Jun cong].

panels.action: Armored Hunter operatives in black combat suits and silver cross visors cordon off the courtyard with glowing barrier pylons.
panels.prose_en: Armored Hunter operatives in black combat suits and silver cross visors cordon off the courtyard with glowing barrier pylons.
panels.prose_hi: Kale combat suit aur chandi ke cross wiser mein bakhtarband hunter karyakarta chamakte avrodhak toranon ke saath aangan ko gherte han.

panels.action: On the security monitor, a grainy freeze-frame catches Ha-Jun's back disappearing into the shadows of the rear campus gate.

dialogue.text: Lekin shikari pahunche... tab tak wo jaa chuka tha.

panels.prose_en: On the security monitor, a grainy freeze-frame catches Ha-Jun's back disappearing into the shadows of the rear campus gate.
panels.prose_hi: Suraksha monitor par, ek danedar fries-frem Ha-Jun ki peeth ko peeche ke parisar ke gate ki chhaya mein gayab hote hue dekhta hai.

panels.action: The frame dissolves into swirling black cosmic clouds beneath a massive, shattered blood-red celestial eclipse.
panels.prose_en: The frame dissolves into swirling black cosmic clouds beneath a massive, shattered blood-red celestial eclipse.
panels.prose_hi: Frem ek vishal, toote hue khoon-lal khagoliya grahan ke neeche ghumte kale brahmandiya baadalon mein vilin ho jata hai.

panels.action: Panoramic establishing shot of the ancient Abyssal Kingdom: Obsidian spires and Gothic castles floating above bubbling oceans of purple magma.

dialogue.text: Insaani duniya se bohot door... Abyss ki gehraiyon mein.

panels.prose_en: Panoramic establishing shot of the ancient Abyssal Kingdom: Obsidian spires and Gothic castles floating above bubbling oceans of purple magma.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin abisal samrajya ka manoram drishya: obsidian minaren aur gothik mahal, baingani magma ke budbudate mahasagaron ke upar tairte hue.

panels.action: Inside a cavernous cathedral of black bone: Gigantic skeletal pillars support a vaulted ceiling draped in crimson banners.
panels.prose_en: Inside a cavernous cathedral of black bone: Gigantic skeletal pillars support a vaulted ceiling draped in crimson banners.
panels.prose_hi: Kali haddi ke gufanuma girjaghar ke ander: vishal kankal ke khambhe lal rang ke banneron mein lipati gunbaddar chhat ko sahara dete han.

panels.action: Seated on a throne of crushed dragon skulls: Demon King Lord Malgath (18 feet tall, four muscular arms, horned obsidian armor, burning skull face).

dialogue.text: First Demon King — Lord Malgath.

panels.prose_en: Seated on a throne of crushed dragon skulls: Demon King Lord Malgath (18 feet tall, four muscular arms, horned obsidian armor, burning skull face).
panels.prose_hi: Kuchali hui dragon khopadiyon ke sinhasan par baitha: danav raja lord Malgath (18 feet lamba, char mansal bhujaen, seeng wala obsidian kavch, jalti hui khopdi wala chehra).

panels.action: Malgath's massive spiked claw violently crushes the skull armrest into powder as his crimson eyes flare with shock.
panels.prose_en: Malgath's massive spiked claw violently crushes the skull armrest into powder as his crimson eyes flare with shock.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ka vishal nukila panja khopdi ke armerest ko hinsak roop se kuchalkar powder bana deta hai, jabki uski lal aankhen sadme se chamak uthti han.

panels.action: Two 10-foot demon generals prostrate on the obsidian floor, trembling: 'H-Huzoor Malgath?! Aapki neend kisne todi?!'

dialogue.text: Huzoor Malgath! Kya gustakhi hui?!

panels.prose_en: Two 10-foot demon generals prostrate on the obsidian floor, trembling: 'H-Huzoor Malgath?! Aapki neend kisne todi?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Do 10 foot ke rakshas senapati obsidian farsh par kampate hue jhuke: 'hujur Malgath?! aapki neend kisne todi?!'

panels.action: Malgath's voice reverberates like tectonic plates grinding: 'Wo seal... First Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: First Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.

panels.prose_en: Malgath's voice reverberates like tectonic plates grinding: 'Wo seal... First Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ki awaz tectonic platon ki pisne jaisi gunjati hai: 'vo sil... pehli Sovereign ki pehli seal toot chuki hai.'

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Malgath's flaming eyes: 'Uska khoon... insaano ki dharti par jaag utha hai.'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: Uska khoon... insaano ke jahan mein jaag utha hai.

panels.prose_en: Malgath's flaming eyes: 'Uska khoon... insaano ki dharti par jaag utha hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ki jalti aankhen: 'uska khun... insaanon ki dharti par jaag utha hai...'.

panels.action: Malgath rises to his full 18-foot height, drawing a colossal serrated greatsword wrapped in glowing black sealing chains.
panels.prose_en: Malgath rises to his full 18-foot height, drawing a colossal serrated greatsword wrapped in glowing black sealing chains.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath apni puri 18 foot ki unchai tak uthta hai, aur chamakti kali sealing janjeeron mein lipati hui ek vishal daatedar mahan talwar khinchta hai.

panels.action: Malgath roars out his decree: 'Teeno Demon Lords ko jagao! Dharti ke darwaze khol do! Us ladke ka dil mujhe laakar do!!'

dialogue.speaker: demon_king_malgath
dialogue.text: TEENO LORDS KO JAGAO! USKA DIL MUJHE LAA KAR DO!!

panels.prose_en: Malgath roars out his decree: 'Teeno Demon Lords ko jagao! Dharti ke darwaze khol do! Us ladke ka dil mujhe laakar do!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ne dahadte hue apna farman jaari kiya: 'tino demon lords ko jagao! dharti ke darvaje khol do! us ladke ka dil mujhe laakar do!!'

panels.action: Vast sweeping shot: Tens of thousands of armored demonic beasts raise spiked halberds and roar under twin red moons.
panels.prose_en: Vast sweeping shot: Tens of thousands of armored demonic beasts raise spiked halberds and roar under twin red moons.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal vyapak shot: hajaron bakhtarband demonic beast kantedar patwar uthate hain aur judwan lal chandramaon ke neeche dahadte han.

panels.action: Triptych split-screen: Left: Hunter Bureau mobilizing SWAT squads. Right: Demon King Malgath raising his sword. Center: Ha-Jun walking calmly in rain.

dialogue.text: Dono dunyaon ne apna agla shikar chun liya tha.

panels.prose_en: Triptych split-screen: Left: Hunter Bureau mobilizing SWAT squads. Right: Demon King Malgath raising his sword. Center: Ha-Jun walking calmly in rain.
panels.prose_hi: Triptich split-scrin: baayen: hunter bureau swat daston ko juta raha hai. daayen: danav raja Malgath apni talwar utha raha hai. kendra: Ha-Jun baarish mein shanti se chal raha hai.

panels.action: Golden-purple system window appears: [ARC 1: THE CURSED FEATHER — COMPLETED] | [SYNCHRONIZATION: 10.0%] | [NEW TITLE: HEIR OF THE ABYSS].

dialogue.text: [ARC 1 COMPLETED] [SYNCHRONIZATION: 10.0%] [TITLE: HEIR OF THE ABYSS]

panels.prose_en: Golden-purple system window appears: [ARC 1: THE CURSED FEATHER — COMPLETED] | [SYNCHRONIZATION: 10.0%] | [NEW TITLE: HEIR OF THE ABYSS].
panels.prose_hi: Golden-bangni system window prakat hoti hai: [ARC 1: shapit pankh - purn] | [sinkranization: 10.0%] | [naya shirshak: rasatal ka varis].

panels.action: Epic Arc 1 finale spread: Ha-Jun stands on an overpass overlooking the sparkling night city, Kuro perched on his shoulder, eyes burning violet: 'Aane do poori duniya ko. Main tayar hoon.'
panels.mood: legend is born, grand arc finale

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aane do poori duniya ko. Main tayar hoon.

panels.prose_en: Epic Arc 1 finale spread: Ha-Jun stands on an overpass overlooking the sparkling night city, Kuro perched on his shoulder, eyes burning violet: 'Aane do poori duniya ko. Main tayar hoon.'.
panels.prose_hi: Epik arc 1 ka antim prasar: Ha-Jun ek overpass par khada hai, jahan se jagmagata raat ka shahar dikhta hai, Kuro uske kandhe par baitha hai, aankhen jalti hui baingani rang ki han: 'aane do puri duniya ko. main taiyar hun.'
